notes.title: Quality of life improvements v1.2.4
notes.content:
Hey all!

I know it has been a while, but here is some features you guys have requested!

What’s new?
The ability to enable/disable the microphone
The ability to change the microphone sensitivity
A % from 0-100 beside the different volume sliders to better visualize the actual volume level
A map to the dock where you see the layout of the forest before you enter it
A cooldown to minnie after she has been spotted by the player

What’s fixed?
Changed the death screen to look better and give tips
Upped the countdown from 7,5 minutes to 8,5 minutes

What’s fixed?
Fixed a spot where you could get stuck inbetween the outhouse and the ground (Thanks KingleWakes!)
Fixed a issue where the "Press Q to drop cargo." would still show after dropping of the cargo at the dock

Do you have any problem with these? bugs, glitches etc?
Please let me know, and I'll try my best to fix them!

Hope you have an awesome day/night!

Cheers,
- Amund / lilleBror

notes.title: Small fixes and name change v1.2.3
notes.content:
Hey all!

Thanks for the great feedback on the update I posted yesterday!
Here are some fixes, but first of all I want to address the name change.

The Title of the game is changed from "Steamboat Willie" to "The Rubberhose Forest" to make the game stand more out on YouTube, Google etc.

I saw when trying to search for the game on YouTube, that the let's play videos of the game got drowned in videoes about the cartoon and in other games that had nothing todo with this game.

I also saw people being confused and commenting on creator's videos and thinking this game was a mod for other games that use Steamboat Willie's charaters and style.
So I chose to change the title to make it easier to find and differentiate from other games.

Keep in mind that it might take some time before Steam updates.

What's changed?
The timer is now changed from 6 minutes to 8 minutes. (let's hope that is enough)

What’s fixed?
A bug where the twigs didn't alert Mickey if you were crouched
A bug where Mickey and Minnie didn't spawn, even after collecting enough cargo.

Do you have any problem with these? bugs, glitches etc?
Please let me know, and I'll try my best to fix them!

Hope you have an awesome day/night!

Cheers,
- Amund / lilleBror

notes.title: Steamboat Willie V 1.2.2
notes.content:
Hey all!

Thanks for the great feedback!
Sorry for the lack of updates the past month, so here is a small update to make it up!

What's changed?
Made the game a darker, and the lantern brighter. (please give feedback on this change)
Toned down the glow of the cargo.
Flashlight will now slowly get dimmer the more you use it.

What’s new?
Twigs will now randomly spawn across the map, alerting Mickey if you were to step on one of them. (Thanks ZeroGravity612 for the idea!)
Cargo boxes can now spawn in different locations across the map.
There is now a line to indicate where your voice should be, go above the line and you alert Mickey.
Added a new achievement.

Do you have any problem with these? bugs, glitches etc?
Please let me know, and I'll try my best to fix them!

Hope you have an awesome day/night!

Cheers,
- Amund / lilleBror

notes.title: Steamboat Willie v1.1.1
notes.content:
Hey all!

Thanks for all the feedback and the kind reviews!
Here are some more tweaks to make the experience even better :)

What’s fixed?
Fixed an issue where Mickey didn’t hear footsteps and cargo being dropped/hit the ground
Fixed an issue where the sound would be gone after opening and closing the pause menu
Added 1 minute to the task timer
Fixed an issue where looking at Minnie wouldn't make her disappear

What’s new?
Added a moon in the sky in the direction of the dock, a path to the ground and 3 new landmarks to make it easier to navigate the forest
Added a more intense camera shake for when you run
Added 4 achievements

Do you have any problem with these? bugs, glitches etc?
Please let me know, and I'll try my best to fix them!

Hope you have an awesome day/night!

Cheers,
- Vander / lilleBror
